cards.target: Allen nhw ddim dod.
cards.english: They couldn't come.

cards.target: Cyn gwneud dim, meddylia.
cards.english: Before doing anything, think.

cards.target: Ga i bwdin, plis?
cards.english: Can I have dessert, please?

cards.target: Anfonwyd y llythyr ddoe.
cards.english: The letter was sent yesterday.
cards.existing: Feminine singular nouns soft-mutate after the article `y`/`yr`/`'r`: `cath → y gath` (the cat), `merch → y ferch` (the girl). Masculine nouns don't mutate. The mutation is your gender check.

cards.target: Weles i ti ddoe.
cards.english: I saw you yesterday. (informal)

cards.target: Ga i lwy, plis?
cards.english: Can I have a spoon, please?

cards.target: Dyw hi ddim yn gyrru.
cards.english: She doesn't drive.

cards.target: Heb os nac oni bai.
cards.english: Without a doubt.

cards.target: Does dim llawer o opsiynau.
cards.english: There aren't many options.

cards.target: Does dim gardd ganddyn nhw.
cards.english: They don't have a garden.

cards.target: Ddaeth e ddim â'i gôt.
cards.english: He didn't bring his coat.

cards.target: Does dim cyfrifiadur ganddo fe.
cards.english: He doesn't own a computer.

cards.target: Wnaeth e ddim mwynhau'r cyngerdd.
cards.english: He didn't enjoy the concert.

cards.target: Wrth gwrs, galwch fi'n 'ti'.
cards.english: Of course, call me 'ti'.

cards.target: Dw i eisiau dringo'r Wyddfa.
cards.english: I want to climb Snowdon.
cards.existing: Want to do something: `eisiau + verb-noun`. `Dw i eisiau mynd` (I want to go). Direct, no preposition needed.

cards.target: Ddaeth hi ddim i'r parti.
cards.english: She didn't come to the party.

cards.target: Dylen ni drio'r bwyty newydd.
cards.english: We should try the new restaurant.

cards.target: Dyw e ddim yn gallu nofio.
cards.english: He can't swim.

cards.target: Dydyn ni ddim wedi gorffen eto.
cards.english: We haven't finished yet.

cards.target: Dyw hi ddim wedi penderfynu eto.
cards.english: She hasn't decided yet.

cards.target: Dydyn ni ddim yn meindio aros.
cards.english: We don't mind waiting.

cards.target: Dw i ddim yn gallu fforddio.
cards.english: I can't afford it.

cards.target: Faswn i ddim yn gwneud hynny.
cards.english: I wouldn't do that.

cards.target: Allwn ni ddim parcio fan hyn.
cards.english: We can't park here.

cards.target: Dyw e ddim yn cofio'r cyfeiriad.
cards.english: He doesn't remember the address.

cards.target: Dyw hi ddim yn credu'r stori.
cards.english: She doesn't believe the story.

cards.target: Da iawn am orffen y cwrs.
cards.english: Well done for finishing the course.

cards.target: Fydd dim cyfarfod yr wythnos hon.
cards.english: There won't be a meeting this week.
cards.existing: Negate future by softening: `bydd → fydd`. `Fydd hi ddim yn dod` (she won't come). Same `ddim` particle as the present negative.

cards.target: Dydyn ni ddim wedi cwrdd o'r blaen.
cards.english: We haven't met before.

cards.target: Dydw i ddim yn hoffi pysgod cregyn.
cards.english: I don't like shellfish.

cards.target: Dydyn nhw ddim yn dod yma'n aml.
cards.english: They don't come here often.

cards.target: Dyw hi ddim yn dod gyda ni.
cards.english: She isn't coming with us.

cards.target: Dyw e ddim yn chwarae unrhyw offeryn.
cards.english: He doesn't play any instruments.

cards.target: Wnaethon ni ddim cynllunio ar gyfer hyn.
cards.english: We didn't plan for this.

cards.target: Dydyn ni ddim yn cytuno â'r penderfyniad.
cards.english: We don't agree with the decision.

cards.target: Os na fydd amser, wnawn ni ddim.
cards.english: If there isn't time, we won't.

cards.target: Gobeithio y caf i'r cyfle i ddiolch.
cards.english: I hope I get the opportunity to thank you.
cards.existing: Passive structure: `cael + ei/eu + verb-noun`. The possessive (`ei/eu`) agrees with the subject's gender/number; the verb-noun stays as is.

cards.target: Dw i ddim wedi gweld y ffilm yna.
cards.english: I haven't seen that film.

cards.target: Dyw e ddim yn gweithio ar ddydd Sadwrn.
cards.english: He doesn't work on Saturdays.

cards.target: Dydyn ni ddim yn gwylio llawer o deledu.
cards.english: We don't watch much television.

cards.target: Dyw hi ddim yn gallu dod i'r cyfarfod.
cards.english: She can't come to the meeting.

cards.target: Oherwydd fy mod i'n sâl, es i ddim.
cards.english: Because I was ill, I didn't go.

cards.target: Dw i angen prynu bara a llaeth heddiw.
cards.english: I need to buy bread and milk today.

cards.target: Mae'r meddyg yn dweud bod rhaid bwyta'n iach.
cards.english: The doctor says I need to eat healthily.

cards.target: Dw i angen prynu tocyn dwyffordd i Aberystwyth.
cards.english: I need to buy a return ticket to Aberystwyth.

cards.target: A gaf i'ch sylw chi, os gwelwch yn dda?
cards.english: May I have your attention, please?

cards.target: Mae'r meddyg yn dweud bod rhaid i fi orffwys.
cards.english: The doctor says I need to rest.
cards.existing: `Rhaid i + person + verb-noun` = 'must / has to'. `Rhaid i fi fynd` = 'I must go'. Literal: 'necessity to me to go'. Welsh frames obligation as a state of necessity.

cards.target: Dw i ddim wedi bod at y deintydd eleni.
cards.english: I haven't been to the dentist this year.

cards.target: Dw i eisiau bara menyn a chaws i frecwast.
cards.english: I want buttered bread and cheese for breakfast.

cards.target: Dydyn ni ddim yn arfer mynd allan ar nosweithiau ysgol.
cards.english: We don't usually go out on school nights.

cards.target: Welon ni ddim byd anarferol.
cards.english: We didn't see anything unusual.

cards.target: Da iawn am gwblhau'r marathon.
cards.english: Well done for completing the marathon.

cards.target: Mae'r iogwrt gyda ffrwythau yn iach iawn.
cards.english: Yoghurt with fruit is very healthy.

cards.target: Mae'r pysgod yn nofio mewn heidiau enfawr.
cards.english: The fish swim in enormous shoals.

cards.target: Mae'r gymuned yma'n gyfeillgar a chroesawgar iawn.
cards.english: This community is very friendly and welcoming.
cards.existing: Aspirate is the easiest to spot – words start with `ch`, `ph`, or `th`. If you see those, the trigger is usually one of: `ei` (her), `tri`, `chwe`, `a`/`â`.

cards.target: Mae'r karaoke yn hwyl ar noson allan.
cards.english: Karaoke is fun on a night out.

cards.target: Mae'r polo dŵr yn gêm gorfforol iawn.
cards.english: Water polo is a very physical game.

cards.target: Croeso cynnes yw'r peth gorau am Gymru.
cards.english: A warm welcome is the best thing about Wales.

cards.target: Mae'r coffi yn gryf iawn ond yn flasus.
cards.english: The coffee is very strong but tasty.

cards.target: Mae'r diwydiant twristiaeth yn cynnal yr economi leol.
cards.english: The tourism industry sustains the local economy.

cards.target: Dw i bob amser wedi eisiau dringo'r Wyddfa.
cards.english: I have always wanted to climb Snowdon.

cards.target: Mae'r gêm fwrdd yn hwyl i'r teulu cyfan.
cards.english: The board game is fun for the whole family.

cards.target: Mae'r gwynt yn chwythu'n gryf o'r gorllewin heddiw.
cards.english: The wind is blowing strongly from the west today.

cards.target: Dyw e ddim wedi bod yng Nghymru o'r blaen.
cards.english: He hasn't been to Wales before.

cards.target: Dw i ddim yn gallu cyrraedd y silff uchaf.
cards.english: I can't reach the top shelf.

cards.target: Mae'r llyfrgell yn cynnig cyrsiau am ddim i oedolion.
cards.english: The library offers free courses for adults.

cards.target: Dw i wedi troi fy migwrn wrth redeg ddoe.
cards.english: I twisted my ankle while running yesterday.

cards.target: Mae'r sloth yn symud yn araf iawn drwy'r coed.
cards.english: The sloth moves very slowly through the trees.

cards.target: Mae fy nghlust yn brifo, efallai bod haint ynddi.
cards.english: My ear hurts, maybe there's an infection in it.

cards.target: Yn y bôn, mae pawb eisiau byw mewn heddwch a harmoni.
cards.english: Basically, everyone wants to live in peace and harmony.

cards.target: Mae'r iaith Gymraeg wedi profi adfywiad yn y degawdau diwethaf diolch i gefnogaeth addysg a'r cyfryngau.
cards.english: The Welsh language has experienced a revival in recent decades thanks to education and media support.

cards.target: Mae'r arennau yn rheoli lefelau hylif.
cards.english: The kidneys regulate fluid levels.

cards.target: Mae'r trowsiwr yn trwsio'r esgidiau lledr.
cards.english: The cobbler repairs the leather shoes.

cards.target: Mae'r peiriannydd yn cyfrifo'r llwyth strwythurol.
cards.english: The engineer calculates the structural load.

cards.target: Mae'r sialc yn fedal ac yn wyn.
cards.english: Chalk is soft and white.

cards.target: Mae'r system iechyd yn wynebu heriau sylweddol.
cards.english: The healthcare system faces significant challenges.

cards.target: Mae'r gweinydd yn storio miliynau o ffeiliau.
cards.english: The server stores millions of files.

cards.target: Mae'r calchfaen yn cynnwys ffosiliau o'r môr hynafol.
cards.english: The limestone contains fossils from the ancient sea.

cards.target: Mae'r cacynen yn adeiladu nyth o dan y bondo.
cards.english: The wasp builds a nest under the eaves.

cards.target: Mae'r broc môr yn cyrraedd y lan gyda'r llanw.
cards.english: The driftwood reaches the shore with the tide.
